Class HistoricalMapDiskCacheManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.HistoricalMapDiskCacheManager
public final class HistoricalMapDiskCacheManager extends Object
Persistence, Disk Caching, and Cartographic Tensor Storage Manager.

Handles reading and writing multi-spectral geographic, demographic, and sociological tensor rasters from standardized epoch directories (data/maps/ether/earth/<year>/) and runtime disk cache storage (data/cache/).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
